title: PsychoSafe: Eliciting Psychologically-Informed Refusals in Large Language Models
title_zh: PsychoSafe：在大语言模型中引出具备心理学依据的拒绝回复
abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) routinely face requests that should be refused, creating a trade-off between helpfulness and harm prevention. However, refusals themselves can be helpful. In high-risk interactions involving crisis, coercion, or escalating intent, blunt non-compliance may prevent direct harm while still failing to support the needs of the person behind the request. We present PsychoSafe, a psychologically-informed refusal framework that reframes refusal as structured supportive communication grounded in evidence-based intervention strategies. To develop PsychoSafe, we construct a corpus of 8019 prompt-response pairs spanning five psychologically salient risk domains and apply prompting and parameter-efficient fine-tuning to Qwen 3.5 27B. On a balanced validation set of 500 prompts, evaluated with an LLM judge and validated through human ratings, PsychoSafe prompting improves overall refusal quality by 28.1% over a generic baseline, with particularly strong gains in external resource referral (+46.8%) and psychological grounding (+34.8%), while preserving downstream performance on non-refusal tasks. Fine-tuning achieves near-perfect refusal and resource-referral rates but reduces response relevance. Additional evaluations on SORRY-Bench and XSTest show strong in-domain robustness but limited out-of-domain generalization, suggesting that future work should diversify fine-tuning data to help models apply interventions selectively rather than schematically.
abstract_zh: 大语言模型（LLMs）经常需要拒绝某些可能造成伤害的请求，这带来了有用性与风险防控之间的权衡。然而，拒绝本身也可以是有帮助的：在危机、胁迫或意图升级等高风险交互中，生硬的不配合虽然可能避免直接伤害，却未必能支持请求背后真实的人的需求。本文提出 PsychoSafe，一个具备心理学依据的拒绝框架，将拒绝重构为基于循证干预策略的结构化支持性沟通。作者构建了包含 8019 个 prompt-response 对的语料库，覆盖五类具有心理显著性的风险领域，并对 Qwen 3.5 27B 进行提示工程与参数高效微调（parameter-efficient fine-tuning）。在包含 500 个提示的均衡验证集上，结合 LLM judge 与人工评分验证，PsychoSafe prompting 相比通用基线将总体拒绝质量提升 28.1%，其中外部资源转介提升 46.8%，心理学依据性提升 34.8%，同时保持非拒绝任务的下游性能。微调版本实现了接近完美的拒绝率和资源转介率，但会降低回复相关性。SORRY-Bench 与 XSTest 上的额外评估显示，该方法具备较强的域内鲁棒性，但域外泛化有限，说明未来需要进一步多样化微调数据，使模型能够选择性而非模板化地应用心理干预策略。
key_points_zh: 提出 PsychoSafe，将安全拒绝从简单“不回答”改造为具备心理学依据的支持性沟通，面向危机、胁迫和意图升级等高风险场景。
构建 8019 个 prompt-response 对的数据集，覆盖五类心理显著风险领域，并基于 Qwen 3.5 27B 进行 prompting 与参数高效微调实验。
在 500 条均衡验证集上，PsychoSafe prompting 相比通用拒绝基线总体质量提升 28.1%，外部资源转介和心理学 grounding 提升尤为明显。
微调可获得接近完美的拒绝与资源转介率，但牺牲了回复相关性，显示安全性与情境贴合度之间仍存在权衡。
在 SORRY-Bench 和 XSTest 上表现出较强域内鲁棒性，但域外泛化有限，未来需扩展数据多样性以避免机械化干预。

llm_assessment.comment: PsychoSafe is useful for refusal-quality governance but is mostly a model-safety and fine-tuning framework rather than an agent-harness contribution.
llm_assessment.comment_zh: PsychoSafe 对拒答质量治理有一定价值，但整体更偏模型安全与微调框架，而非智能体基础设施。
